title: WU JEN FIRST LEVEL SPELLS - the 30 first level wu jen spells with the school, component, casting time, saving throw, reversible and element codes
audit_label: R670 OA wu jen first level spells audit
audit_comment: OA round fifty-seven (capture pp. 155-165): the wu jen first level spell stat blocks - the school, component, casting time and saving throw codes with the reversible and element markers, cross-checked spell by spell between the passes

banner.title: WU JEN FIRST LEVEL SPELLS, printed capture pp. 155-165 - the OA wu jen first level spells round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read (print pp. 155-165; compressed pp. 75-79); all 30 stat blocks cross-checked spell by spell between the passes, zero contested stat reads - the variances are typographic (the print's fumble-lingers against the compressed fumble-fingers for the prestidigitation reverse, the print's pared for para-elemental in the melt prose). The level is alteration-heavy: 15 of the 30 spells, conjuration six, divination three, enchantment/charm, evocation and illusion two each - no necromantic or abjuration. The component census carries two oddities pinned as cells: ventriloquism the lone V,M without the somatic (bitmask 5), and secret signs the Components: Special line (bitmask 0, none of the three - the component is whatever method sends the message, the spell castable even bound and gagged). Elemental burst alone takes the half save (the sliver and spark damage halved); drowsy insects and hypnotism the negation saves; four the special. The casting times run 13 one-segment up through 12 one-round, with warp wood the lone four-segment and fiery eyes and ghost light the five-segment pair. Six spells read Reversible (accuracy, comprehend languages, prestidigitation, read magic, still water, swim). The sixth column cross-checks the R669 element grid: the 12 tagged cells matching the landed dieWJT66L1Element pins exactly. The stat grid pins as a table: 30 rows the spell ordinals, six columns - school, components (a V=1 S=2 M=4 bitmask), casting time in segments (1 round = 10), saving throw code (0 none, 1 neg., 2 special, 3 half), reversible and element markers. The spell names ride the column comments, the prose descriptions close in their own rounds. The table tag WJL1Data identifier-safe per the R639 lesson
